title: Breath of Life
story:
A small boy once received a balloon from a street vendor.

He tried to blow it up.

But no matter how hard he tried, it remained small.

His father smiled and took the balloon.

With one deep breath, he filled it.

The balloon grew bigger and brighter.

The boy watched in amazement.

“Wow… it came alive,” he said.

His father gently replied,

“It needed breath.”

In life, we often try to do everything on our own.

We depend on our strength.

Our plans.

Our abilities.

But without God, we feel empty.

We feel incomplete.

It is His Spirit that gives us life.

It is His breath that fills us.

When we invite Him in,

our lives gain purpose.

Strength.

Meaning.

We were never meant to live without Him.

Because He is the source of life itself.
life_lesson:
God’s Spirit is the source of your life and strength.

Without Him, life feels empty. With Him, life has purpose.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for giving me life.

Thank You for Your Spirit within me.

Help me not to depend only on myself.

Fill me with Your presence each day.

Give my life purpose and direction.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you trying to live life on your own strength?

Do you invite God into your daily life?

How can you depend more on His Spirit today?
verse:
The Spirit of God has made me.
The breath of the Almighty gives me life.
